site.title: The Best Is Yet to Come
site.intro: 57 years behind you. So many beautiful miles still ahead.
site.finalLetter:
Happy 57th Birthday, Nannagaru! ❤️

If there's one thing we wish we could give you today, it's the chance to see yourself through our eyes, even if just for a moment.

To us, you've always been so much more than the person who takes care of everything. You're the person we've looked up to, learned from, laughed with, and grown up knowing we could always count on.

As we've grown older, we've begun to understand things we probably took for granted when we were little. The thought you've put into our lives, the countless ways you've looked out for us, and the love you've shown in ways that didn't always need words.

We may not say it often enough, Dad, but we notice. And we appreciate you more than you know.

Looking through all these photographs, it's amazing how much has changed. We've grown up, life has taken us in different directions, and the years seem to have passed before any of us quite realised it. But no matter how old we get or where life takes us, we'll always be your children, and you'll always be our Dad.

And if there's one thing we want you to remember as you turn 57, it's that you don't always have to be the one thinking about everyone else. Your happiness matters to us just as much as ours has always mattered to you.

We hope the coming years bring you moments that are entirely your own, things that make you smile for no particular reason, and days that leave you feeling genuinely happy.

We don't know exactly what the years ahead will look like. But we do know that we want you to be a part of so many of our happiest moments, just as you've been a part of everything that brought us here.

And we hope we get to be there for so many of yours, too.

So here's to 57 years of your story, Dad. To everything that has made you who you are, and to all the wonderful things that are still waiting to become part of it.

Happy Birthday, Nannagaru. We love you, always. ❤️

With all our love,
Tejaswini & Sudhu

futureScenes.caption: So many more memories waiting to be made, together.

stops.title: Where the Journey Began
stops.subtitle: Every journey starts somewhere.
stops.headline: The beginning of a beautiful story.
stops.story:
Every journey begins long before we know where life will take us.

There was once a young boy with dreams, hopes, and an entire future waiting to unfold. He couldn't have known all the places life would take him, the challenges he would overcome, or the family he would one day build.

Looking back at these early chapters reminds us just how far you've come, Nannagaru.

And the beautiful thing is, your story is still being written.

photos.caption: A glimpse into his school days — where the journey began.

stops.title: The Road You Built
stops.subtitle: Every mile has brought you further than you once imagined.
stops.headline: All that you have built.
stops.story:
There are so many years between that young boy in the school photograph and the person standing here today.

Years of learning, working hard, making decisions, facing challenges, and finding your way forward, one step at a time.

You've built a career, crossed oceans, and come a long way from where your journey began. And behind all of that are years of dedication, perseverance, and quiet determination.

I hope you take a moment to look back and feel proud of everything you've accomplished, Nannagaru.

Because sometimes, when we're busy looking toward the next responsibility, we forget to appreciate just how far we've already travelled.

photos.caption: A journey of hard work, perseverance, and new horizons.

stops.title: The Family We Built Together
stops.subtitle: The people who made every journey worthwhile.
stops.headline: The people who made it home.
stops.story:
Somewhere along the way, your journey became our journey.

You and Amma built a family, and with it came a lifetime of moments that we will always carry with us.

Looking at these photographs, I see more than just how much we've grown. I see all the years we've spent together, the places we've been, the celebrations we've shared, and the countless ordinary days that became memories without us even realising it.

From the days when Sudhu and I were little to the people we're becoming today, you've been there through so many chapters of our lives.

And while the years have changed all of us, one thing hasn't changed: you're still our Dad, and we'll always be your children, no matter how old we get.

There are so many memories behind us, and I hope we have countless more waiting ahead.

Because the best part of this journey has always been getting to share it together.

photos.caption: The early chapters of our family story.
The two people who started it all.
No matter how much we grow, we'll always be your little ones.

stops.title: A Life Beyond Work
stops.subtitle: There's still so much life to enjoy.
stops.headline: There is more than work ahead.
stops.story:
The next chapter doesn't have to look like the last one. There can be family trips, places you've always wanted to see, hobbies to rediscover, unhurried mornings, and time to simply enjoy the life you've built.

You don't have to race toward every next thing. You're allowed to slow down, rest, and choose what makes you happy.

photos.caption: The beautiful places we've discovered together.
Some of the best memories are made along the way.
Little adventures that became lasting memories.
There's always another beautiful place waiting to be explored.
And so many more adventures still ahead.
